Soft Signal

By Brad Necyk · 2026

A picture with weight.

Take hold of a corner, an edge, or somewhere in the middle. Pull upward. Let go, and give the image time to return.

Mouse or touch to hold and pull.
Space to hold the lower center; arrows to pull.
Space or Escape to release. R to begin again.
F for full screen. I for this window.

An original generated image, recalling the ray-traced worlds of the early 1990s. Your own image stays in this browser.

The image is at rest.
